person.summary: Solutions Engineering professional with 8+ years across Cisco, Honeywell, and enterprise technology, ready to step into people leadership as a Manager of Systems or Solutions Engineering. Combines current pre-sales depth with prior people-management experience and measurable customer outcomes.

Mentored and onboarded engineers domestically and internationally at Honeywell with structured retrospectives and feedback cycles.
